sources.creator: Piotr Kilanowski
sources.researchNote: Kilanowski identifies Wilcza 29 as a tenement designed by Henryk Stifelman and Stanisław Weiss. Drawing on the Capital City Reconstruction Office file APW 5069, he documents its post-war condition, the progressive collapse of the central part of the front building on 22 July 1945, the subsequent demolition of dangerous upper sections, and the surviving western and rear fragments. The article reproduces a 1945 floor-plan diagram and a photograph from the BOS file and distinguishes Wilcza 29 from the neighbouring Wilcza 29A, attributed to Wacław Heppen and Józef Napoleon Czerwiński.

places.publicNote: Warsaw address associated with Kaper in university and police documentation. The tenement, designed by Henryk Stifelman and Stanisław Weiss, was partly demolished and substantially rebuilt after 1945; its post-war condition is documented in the files of the Capital City Reconstruction Office (APW, file 5069).
